`vendor/anti-slop/` and `vendor/anti-slop.lock.json` are generated by
`bun run sync-anti-slop` and shipped inside the npm package. Do not edit by hand.

`vendor/kira/` is a curated, effect-free port of five comment/test-hygiene rules from
Kiranaide/t3-kira (`oxlint-plugin-t3code`); see `vendor/kira/UPSTREAM.md`. It is maintained
by hand: after reviewed edits run `node scripts/sync-anti-slop.ts --rehash-kira`.
`bun run check-vendor` verifies both copies against their locks.
